findings.motion: listed as a co-author of HB 5337
findings.note: The official bill page lists him among the co-authors of HB 5337 by Isaac, relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote and creating criminal offenses. The page shows the House committee report sent to Calendars on 2025-05-07 and names SB 16 by Hughes as its identical companion. The page does not give the date he was added as co-author.

findings.motion: listed as a co-author of HB 4962
findings.note: The official bill page lists him among the co-authors of HB 4962 by Pierson and Louderback, relating to the disclosure of citizenship of a candidate for public office. The last action shown is referral to the Elections committee on 2025-04-03. The page does not give the date he was added as co-author. Related topic: citizenship checks for candidates, not voters.
